The bug was in the credit-update logic: when a send and a credit return happened in the same cycle, only one of the two effects was applied (the `if (credit_return) ... else if (send)` structure ignored concurrent sends during a return). I replaced it with the spec's full-precision `S = credits - send + R` calculation that always accounts for both events, with saturation/error logic applied to that combined value.

The design is now fixed — `iverilog -g2012 -o sim tb/tb_visible.v rtl/*.v && vvp sim` reports **TEST PASSED** with no errors.
